original: devetyādi | he deva manuṣyāsuranatacaraṇa he pratihatajanmajarārujamaraṇa he lokeśa aśaraṇyaṃ śaraṇahīnaṃ māṃ tvaṃ rakṣa pālaya + (pālayeti?) saṃbandhaḥ | he kṛpālo he dayālo tvaṃ kāruṇyaṃ karuṇābhāvaṃ kurv iti dvitīyaḥ saṃbandhaḥ |
analyzed: deva ityādi he deva manuṣya asura nata caraṇa he pratihata janma jarā ruja maraṇa he lokeśa aśaraṇyam śaraṇa hīnam mām tvam rakṣa pālaya pālaya iti saṃbandhaḥ he kṛpālo he dayālo tvam kāruṇyam karuṇā bhāvam kuru iti dvitīyaḥ saṃbandhaḥ

original: devāś ca manuṣyāś cāsurāś ca te devamanuṣyāsurās tair nataṃ caraṇaṃ yasya sa devamanuṣyāsuranatacaraṇas tasyāmantraṇaṃ he devamanuṣyāsuranatacaraṇa | etena devamanuṣyeṣu bha[2r]gavān śāsteti sūcitam | janma ca jarā ca rujaṃ maraṇaṃ ca taj janmajarārujamaraṇaṃ |
analyzed: devāḥ ca manuṣyāḥ ca asurāḥ ca te deva manuṣya asurāḥ taiḥ natam caraṇam yasya sa deva manuṣya asura nata caraṇaḥ tasya āmantraṇam he deva manuṣya asura nata caraṇa etena deva manuṣyeṣu bha2rgavān śāstā iti sūcitam janma ca jarā ca rujam maraṇam ca tat janma jarā ruja maraṇam

original: pratihataṃ nirākṛtaṃ janmajarārujamaraṇaṃ yena sa pratihatajanmajarārujamaraṇas tasya saṃbodhanaṃ he pratihatajanmajarārujamaraṇa | anenāpi bhagavataḥ prahāṇasaṃpad udīritā | lokānām īśo lokeśas tasyābhimukhīkaraṇaṃ he lokeśa | anenāpi bhagavataḥ prāptisaṃpad udbhāvitā | rakṣety anena parārthasaṃpat kathitā |
analyzed: pratihatam nirākṛtam janma jarā ruja maraṇam yena sa pratihata janma jarā ruja maraṇaḥ tasya saṃbodhanam he pratihata janma jarā ruja maraṇa anena api bhagavataḥ prahāṇa saṃpad udīritā lokānām īśaḥ lokeśaḥ tasya abhimukhīkaraṇam he lokeśa anena api bhagavataḥ prāpti saṃpad udbhāvitā rakṣā iti anena parārtha saṃpad kathitā

original: kāruṇyaṃ kurv ity anena karuṇāsaṃpat prakaṭitā || 1 ||
analyzed: kāruṇyam kuru iti anena karuṇā saṃpad prakaṭitā

original: saṃsāretyādi | he mahākṛpa he mahādayālo tvaṃ māṃ mā 'vadhīrayeti saṃbandhaḥ | kathaṃbhūtaṃ saṃsārodadhimadhyanimagnam | punaḥ kathaṃbhūtam | kleśamahormisamāhitabhagnam | punaḥ [2v] kathaṃbhūtam | viruvantam | he mahākṛpa tvaṃ māṃ pāhi iti dvitīyaḥ saṃbandhaḥ | ahaṃ bhavantaṃ naumi | iti tṛtīyaḥ saṃbandhaḥ | mā'vadhīraya mā helāṃ kuru |
analyzed: saṃsāra ityādi he mahā kṛpa he mahā dayālo tvam mām mā vadhīraya iti saṃbandhaḥ kathaṃbhūtam saṃsāra udadhi madhya nimagnam punar kathaṃbhūtam kleśa mahā ūrmi samāhita bhagnam punar kathaṃbhūtam viruvantam he mahā kṛpa tvam mām pāhi iti dvitīyaḥ saṃbandhaḥ aham bhavantam naumi iti tṛtīyaḥ saṃbandhaḥ mā avadhīraya mā helām kuru

original: saṃsāra eva udadhiḥ samudras tasya madhyaṃ tatra nimagnam adhogatam | kleśā eva mahormayaḥ kallolās taiḥ samāhitaṃ samyag āropitaṃ bhagnam | viruvantaṃ rudantam | evaṃviśiṣṭaṃ māṃ tvaṃ pāhi rakṣa | ahaṃ bhavantaṃ lokeśaṃ naumi namaskaromi trāṇāśayety arthaḥ || 2 ||
analyzed: saṃsāraḥ eva udadhiḥ samudraḥ tasya madhyam tatra nimagnam adhas gatam kleśāḥ eva mahā ūrmayaḥ kallolāḥ taiḥ samāhitam samyak āropitam bhagnam viruvantam rudantam evaṃviśiṣṭam mām tvam pāhi rakṣa aham bhavantam lokeśam naumi namaskaromi trāṇa āśaya iti arthaḥ

original: tṛṣṇetyādi | he bhagavan he aiśvaryādiguṇavan | tvaṃ māṃ pālaya rakṣa | na kevalaṃ pālaya avalokaya paśya | kathaṃbhūtaṃ bhṛṣṇā timiropadrutanetram | punaḥ kathaṃbhūtam | maraṇamahābhayavihvalagātram | yāvad ahaṃ viṣamām avīciṃ na yāmi [3r] iti saṃbandhaḥ | tṛṣṇā eva timiram andhakāraḥ | tenopadrutaṃ vyākulaṃ netraṃ nayanaṃ yasya tam |
analyzed: tṛṣṇā ityādi he bhagavan he aiśvarya ādi guṇavan tvam mām pālaya rakṣa na kevalam pālaya avalokaya paśya kathaṃbhūtam bhṛṣṇā timira upadruta netram punar kathaṃbhūtam maraṇa mahā bhaya vihvala gātram yāvat aham viṣamām avīcim na yāmi iti saṃbandhaḥ tṛṣṇā eva timiram andhakāraḥ tena upadrutam vyākulam netram nayanam yasya tam

original: maraṇam eva mahābhayaṃ tena vihvalaṃ samāyattaṃ (?) gātraṃ śarīraṃ yasya tam | evaṃvidhaṃ māṃ he bhagavan he bhagnamāra tvaṃ pālaya rakṣa | avalokaya paśya | yāvacchabdo 'vadhau | viṣamāṃ dāruṇām avīciṃ narakaṃ yāvan na yāmi na prāpnomi tāvad eva rakṣāyā avasara iti sūcitam || 3 ||
analyzed: maraṇam eva mahā bhayam tena vihvalam samāyattam gātram śarīram yasya tam evaṃvidham mām he bhagavan he bhagnamāra tvam pālaya rakṣa avalokaya paśya yāvat śabdaḥ vadhau viṣamām dāruṇām avīcim narakam yāvat na yāmi na prāpnomi tāvat eva rakṣāyāḥ avasaraḥ iti sūcitam 30

original: ity anantaroktaprakāraiś caturviṃśatibhiḥ ślokaiḥ bhagavataḥ smaraṇaṃ bhagavatsmaraṇaṃ tena yat puṇyaṃ yat kuśalam asti tena kuśalena idaṃ jagad ayaṃ lokaḥ | akṣuṇṇaṃ avandhyaṃ yathā bhavati evaṃ śrīpotalakaś cāsāv acalaś ceti śrīpotalakācalaḥ tasmin vāsaḥ sthitiṃ labhatāṃ prāpnuvantu | vividhaś cāsau vilāsaś ceti vividhavilāsaḥ |
